1  entire records connected with the impugned notification issued by th  respondent in Notification No.02/MRB/2021 as p  "DINAKARAN" dated 28.09.2021 and quash the same and consequently  direct the 2nd and 3rd respondents to consider the petitioner for th  Food Safety Officer and notify the appointment of Food Safety Office  afresh in accordance with Sec. 37 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 
 For Petitioners : Mr.C.Rajaguru  For R1 & R3 : Mr.P.Baladhandayutham  Special Government Pleader  For R4 : Mr.M.Loganathan  ORDER Heard Mr.C.Rajaguru, learned counsel for the petitioner, Mr.P.Baladhandayutham, learned Special Government Pleader for the respondents 1 and 3 and Mr.M.Loganathan, learned counsel for the fourth respondent.
There is no appearance on behalf of the second respondent.
2. The petitioner challenges the recruitment notification dated 28.09.2021, in which applications were called for the post of Food Safety Officer.
The crucial date of the notification in the website is 30.09.2021 and the last date of submission of application is 21.10.2021.
The written examination was also conducted in the month of November, 2021.
Though the petitioner had filed the present Writ Petition even before the last date of submission of the application, much water has flown under the bridge.

Since the learned counsel for the fourth respondent submitted that the selection has been completed and appointment orders are already approved, at this juncture, interference to the recruitment process would not be appropriate.
4. Accordingly, the Writ Petition stands dismissed.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
